59181-tetherstones.title: Tetherstones
59181-tetherstones.creator: Ethel M. Dell
59181-tetherstones.description: A book by Ethel M. Dell. Twelve deep notes sounded from the clock-tower of the Cathedral, and the Bishop’s secretary dropped her hands from her typewriter and turned her face to the open window with a quick sigh. The Bishop’s garden lay sleeping in the sunshine—the pure white of lilies and royal blue of delphiniums mingling together as the wrought silks on the fringe of an altar-cloth.

64767-the-southern-literary-messenger-vo.title: The Southern Literary Messenger Vol Ii No 1 December 1835
64767-the-southern-literary-messenger-vo.creator: Unknown
64767-the-southern-literary-messenger-vo.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is a part of our present plan, to insert _all original communications_ as editorial; that is, simply to omit the words "For the Southern Literary Messenger" at the head of such articles:--unless the contributor shall especially desire to have that caption prefixed, or there be something which requires it in the nature of the article itself. _Selected articles_, of course, will bear some appropriate token of their origin.

arxiv-1903-03597.title: ShiftsReduce: Minimizing Shifts in Racetrack Memory 4.0
arxiv-1903-03597.creator: Asif Ali Khan, Fazal Hameed, Robin Bläsing, Stuart Parkin, Jeronimo Castrillon
arxiv-1903-03597.description: Abstract Racetrack memories (RMs) have significantly evolved since their conception in 2008, making them a serious contender in the field of emerging memory technologies. Despite key technological advancements, the access latency and energy consumption of an RM-based system are still highly influenced by the number of shift operations.

arxiv-1910-02312.title: ExpertMatcher: Automating ML Model Selection for Users in Resource Constrained Countries
arxiv-1910-02312.creator: Vivek Sharma, Praneeth Vepakomma, Tristan Swedish, Ken Chang, Jayashree Kalpathy-Cramer, Ramesh Raskar
arxiv-1910-02312.description: Abstract In this work we introduce ExpertMatcher, a method for automating deep learning model selection using autoencoders. Specifically, we are interested in performing inference on data sources that are distributed across many clients using pretrained expert ML networks on a centralized server. The ExpertMatcher assigns the most relevant model(s) in the central server given the client’s data representation.

arxiv-2003-03513.title: Finiteness of meromorphic mappings from Kähler manifold into projective space
arxiv-2003-03513.creator: Pham Duc Thoan, Nguyen Dang Tuyen, Noulorvang Vangty
arxiv-2003-03513.description: Abstract . The purpose of this paper is to prove the finiteness theorems for meromorphic mappings of a complete connected Kähler manifold into projective space sharing few hyperplanes in subgeneral position without counting multiplicity, where all zeros with multiplicities more than a certain number are omitted. Our results are extensions and generalizations of some recent ones.

arxiv-2102-00916.title: A Note on Effects of Generalized and Extended Uncertainty Principles on Jüttner Gas
arxiv-2102-00916.creator: Hooman Moradpour 1 , Sara Aghababaei 2 , Amir Hadi Ziaie 1
arxiv-2102-00916.description: Abstract In recent years, the implications of the generalized (GUP) and extended (EUP) uncertainty prin-ciples on Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution have been widely investigated. However, at high energy regimes, the validity of Maxwell-Boltzmann statistics is under debate and instead, the Jüttner distribution is proposed as the distribution function in relativistic limit.

arxiv-2103-11366.title: Current Advances in Computational Lung Ultrasound Imaging: A Review
arxiv-2103-11366.creator: Tianqi Yang, Oktay Karakuş, Nantheera Anantrasirichai, Alin Achim
arxiv-2103-11366.description: Abstract In the field of biomedical imaging, ultrasonography has become common practice, and used as an important auxiliary diagnostic tool with unique advantages, such as being non-ionising and often portable. This article reviews the state of the art in medical ultrasound image processing and in particular its applications in the examination of the lungs.

arxiv-2105-00418.title: Cost vector analysis & multi-path entanglement routing in quantum networks
arxiv-2105-00418.creator: Hudson Leone, Ashe Miller, Deepesh Singh, Nathan K. Langford, Peter P. Rohde
arxiv-2105-00418.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hudson Leone, Ashe Miller, Deepesh Singh, Nathan K. Langford, Peter P. Rohde. We present a static framework for analysing quantum routing protocols that we call the cost-vector formalism . Here, quantum networks are recast as multi-graphs where edges represent two-qubit entanglement resources that could exist under some sequence of operations. Each edge is weighted with a transmission probability that represents the likelihood of the pair existing and a coherence probability which is the likelihood that the pair is suitable for teleportation.

arxiv-2207-06251.title: Conflict graphs of maximally planar subgraphs of Petersen family graphs
arxiv-2207-06251.creator: Joel Foisy, Justin Raimondi
arxiv-2207-06251.description: Abstract The purpose of this paper is to show that all maximally planar subgraphs of graphs in the Petersen Family have associated conflict graphs unbalanced. All but three strong conflict graphs arising from Petersen Family Graphs are unbalanced, and the three that are balanced all come from K 4 , 4 − e K_{4,4}-e .

arxiv-2311-00446.title: Weyl Group Representation of Billiard Trajectories for One-dimensional Hard Sphere Dynamics
arxiv-2311-00446.creator: Mark Wilkinson
arxiv-2311-00446.description: Abstract We present an exact formula for the dynamics of N N hard spheres of radius r > 0 r>0 on an infinite line which evolve under the assumption that total linear momentum and kinetic energy of the system is conserved for all times. This model is commonly known as the one-dimensional Tonks gas or the hard rod gas model.

arxiv-2402-10916.title: PDM relativistic quantum oscillator in Einstein-Maxwell-Lambda space-time
arxiv-2402-10916.description: Abstract In this analysis, we study the relativistic dynamics of quantum oscillator fields within the context of a position-dependent mass (PDM) system in the background of a curved space-time. The chosen curved space-time is generated by a magnetic field incorporating a non-zero cosmological constant called Einstein-Maxwell-Lambda solution.

arxiv-2509-24580.title: SAIP: A Plug-and-Play Scale-adaptive Module in Diffusion-based Inverse Problems
arxiv-2509-24580.creator: Lingyu Wang, Xiangming Meng
arxiv-2509-24580.description: Abstract Solving inverse problems with diffusion models has shown promise in tasks such as image restoration. A common approach is to formulate the problem in a Bayesian framework and sample from the posterior by combining the prior score with the likelihood score. Since the likelihood term is often intractable, estimators like DPS, DMPS, and π \pi GDM are widely adopted.

arxiv-2601-04916.title: Discovery of a new weberite-type antiferroelectric: La 3 NbO 7
arxiv-2601-04916.creator: Louis Alaerts, Jesse Schimpf, Xinyan Li, Jiongzhi Zheng, Ella Banyas, Jeffrey B. Neaton, Sinéad M. Griffin, Yimo Han, Lane W. Martin, Geoffroy Hautier
arxiv-2601-04916.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Antiferroelectrics are antipolar materials which possess an electric field-induced phase transition to a polar, ferroelectric phase and offer significant potential for sensing/actuation and energy-storage applications. Known antiferroelectrics are relatively scarce and mainly based on a limited set of perovskite materials and their alloys ( e.g. , \text{PbZrO}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}} , \text{AgNbO}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}} , and \text{NaNbO}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{3}}} ).

britannica-1911-jordanus.title: Jordanus (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-jordanus.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-jordanus.description: Article 'Jordanus' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. at Séverac in Aveyron, north-east of Toulouse. In 1302 he may have accompanied the famous Thomas of Tolentino, via Negropont, to the East; but it is only in 1321 that we definitely discover him in western India, in the company of the same Thomas and certain other Franciscan missionaries on their way to China.

openalex-w7212161373.title: O PROCESSO DE ESCRITA DO GÊNERO FÁBULA NA ESCOLA: DO PLANEJAMENTO À REESCRITA DO TEXTO
openalex-w7212161373.creator: Valdineia Barreto Coelho, Cristiane Santos Silva, Gilsonia Portela dos Santos, Cleide Alves de Almeida, Rosimery Costa Oliveira
openalex-w7212161373.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7212161373.description: Este artigo tem como objetivo refletir sobre o ensino da produção textual na escola, compreendendo a escrita como um processo constituído por diferentes etapas, e analisar as contribuições da mediação docente, da correção e da reescrita para a aprendizagem do gênero fábula no 6º

pmc-10557138.title: Immunocomplexed Antigen Capture and Identification by Native Top-Down Mass Spectrometry
pmc-10557138.creator: John P McGee, Rafael D Melani, Ben Des Soye, Derek Croote, Valerie Winton, Stephen R Quake, Jared O Kafader, Neil L Kelleher
pmc-10557138.description: Antibody–antigen interactions are central to the immune response. Variation of protein antigens such as isoforms and post-translational modifications can alter their antibody binding sites. To directly connect the recognition of protein antigens with their molecular composition, we probed antibody–antigen complexes by using native tandem mass spectrometry.

pmc-10741900.title: A Novel Mutation in Sacsin, p.Val1335IIe, May Cause Late-Onset Sacsinopathy Due to Haploinsufficiency
pmc-10741900.creator: Danyeong Kim, Nayoung Ryoo, Young Ho Park, Eva Bagyinszky, Seong Soo Alexander An, SangYun Kim, Alin Ciobica
pmc-10741900.description: Autosomal recessive spastic ataxia in Charlevoix-Saguenay (ARSACS) is a neurodegenerative disorder caused by mutations in the sacsin molecular chaperone protein (SACS) gene. Since the first report from Quebec in 1978, many pathogenic ARSACS variants with significantly reduced chaperone activities have been reported worldwide in adolescents, with presumably altered protein folding. In this study, a novel SACS mutation (p.

pmc-11356985.title: Use of Dietary Supplements among Polish Children with Inflammatory Bowel Disease: A Two-Center Pilot Study
pmc-11356985.creator: Monika Maćków, Agnieszka Kozioł-Kozakowska, Magdalena Szeląg, Tomasz Pytrus, Ewa Raczkowska, Katarzyna Neubauer, Ireneusz Zawiślak, Robert Gajda, Marta Habánová, Andrzej Stawarski, Qingsen Shang
pmc-11356985.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) includes Crohn’s disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC). These diseases are characterized by inflammation, which may be a consequence of changes in the intestinal microbiota and lead to mineral and vitamin deficiencies. The aims of this study were to determine the level of dietary supplement intake in children with IBD and to determine the influence of factors such as sex, nutritional status, diet, and other comorbidities on supplement intake.

pmc-11713137.title: Tracking the timeline: from initial documentation of cognitive decline to dementia diagnosis in the electronic health records
pmc-11713137.creator: Liqin Wang, Richard Yang, David W Bates, Li Zhou, Gad A Marshall
pmc-11713137.description: BackgroundRecent breakthroughs in the treatment of Alzheimer’s Disease underscore the critical needs for early detection. In clinical settings, the diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) is often delayed or overlooked, potentially missing critical opportunities for timely care and treatment.

pmc-12515013.title: Effect of Intravenous Esketamine on Rebound Pain Following Single-Shot Brachial Plexus Block in Patients Undergoing Shoulder Arthroscopic Surgery: A Prospective, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study
pmc-12515013.creator: Jiale Chen, Zhihao Pan, Jinwei Zheng
pmc-12515013.description: PurposeRebound pain (RP) often occurs after the resolution of peripheral nerve blocks. Studies suggest that perineural esketamine prolongs block duration and reduces RP incidence. This study aimed to determine whether intravenous esketamine reduces RP incidence following single-shot interscalene brachial plexus block (ISBPB) in shoulder arthroscopic surgery.

pmc-12608920.title: Nicotinamide Counteracts the Detrimental Effect of Endothelin-1 on Uterine Decidualization During Early Pregnancy by Influencing EDNRB
pmc-12608920.creator: Yuye Wang, Qing Ma, Meitong Chen, Yukako Kayashima, Jiayi Zhou, Balaji Rao, Jessica L. Bowser, Xianwen Yi, Nobuyo Maeda-Smithies, Feng Li
pmc-12608920.description: Highlights What are the main findings? ET-1 impairs endometrial decidualization and angiogenesis during early pregnancy.Nicotinamide (NAM) treatment mitigates the detrimental effect of ET-1. What is the implication of the main finding? ET-1 causes insufficient decidualization, leading to impaired implantation and subsequent manifestation of preeclampsia.

pmc-12621644.title: Synthesis and characterization of a isothiouronium-calix[4]arene derivative: self-assembly and anticancer activity
pmc-12621644.creator: Giuseppe Granata, Loredana Ferreri, Claudia Giovanna Leotta, Giovanni Mario Pitari, Grazia Maria Letizia Consoli
pmc-12621644.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Calix[n]arenes are polyphenolic macrocycles known for their remarkable synthetic versatility, which supports their broad application in various areas, including drug discovery. Their unique conformational features, functionality, and low toxicity make calixarene derivatives valuable drug candidates against cancer. The aim of the present study was the synthesis and characterization of a calix[4]arene derivative in which known anticancer isothiouronium groups were clustered on a calix[4]arene scaffold bearing long C12 alkyl chains at the lower rim.

pmc-12678145.title: Running on the edge: hematological responses to a non-stop ultramarathon with a focus on nitric oxide–mediated red blood cell deformability
pmc-12678145.creator: Marijke Grau, Jonas Bruns, Magnus Stücher, Lucas John, Moritz Munk, Michael Siebers, Christoph Siebers, Wilhelm Bloch, Daniel A. Bizjak
pmc-12678145.description: Background/ObjectiveUltramarathon competitions represent an extreme challenge for the human body, stressing physiological systems. However, little is known about their effects on the red blood cell (RBC) system, particularly on RBC deformability. Moreover, potential modulators of RBC deformability, such as oxidative stress and nitric oxide (NO) signaling, have not yet been systematically investigated in the context of ultramarathon running.

pmc-12717347.title: “Freely explore this environment”: individual differences in exploration behavior and survey knowledge
pmc-12717347.creator: Veronica Muffato, Laura Miola, Sara Errigo, Francesca Pazzaglia, Chiara Meneghetti
pmc-12717347.description: When navigating individuals form mental representations of their environment. Significant individual differences exist, particularly in the ability to develop survey knowledge—a map-like understanding of spatial relationships. While many studies have focused on navigation via predetermined routes, less is known about individual differences in learning environments from free exploration.

pmc-12812679.title: Self-disturbance in first-episode psychosis: Theoretical framework and potential cannabis interactions - a systematic review
pmc-12812679.creator: Valerio Ricci, Domenico De Berardis, Giovanni Martinotti, Giuseppe Maina
pmc-12812679.description: Cannabis use represents a significant environmental risk factor for psychotic disorders, with emerging evidence suggesting complex interactions between cannabinoid exposure, dissociative experiences, and fundamental disturbances of self-experience (self-disorders) in early psychosis. This systematic review examines the phenomenological and neurobiological relationships among dissociation, cannabis use, and self-disturbance in first-episode psychosis (FEP) patients.

pmc-13020464.title: Macrophage metabolic exhaustion and PANoptotic cell death drive chronic tissue inflammation in rheumatoid arthritis
pmc-13020464.creator: Tao Huang, Yoshinori Takashima, Jitendra Kumar, Jose Morales, Kevin Le, Zhensheng Hu, Selene Rubino, Robert T. Trousdale, Gerald J. Berry, Jorg J. Goronzy, Cornelia M. Weyand
pmc-13020464.description: SUMMARYIn the autoimmune disease rheumatoid arthritis, the inflammatory response evolves from protective to pathogenic, causing tissue destruction. Rheumatoid synovitis persists despite the presence of pro-repair SELENOPhiMerTK+CD206+ macrophages, suggesting that these cells acquire pro-arthritogenic functions. Patient-derived synovial SELENOPhiMerTK+CD206+ macrophages produced high concentrations of the complement component C1q and concurrently expressed its receptor, C1QBP.

pmc-13208446.title: Influence of Finer Ceramic Roof-Tile Waste Powder as a Cement Substitute on Mortar Properties
pmc-13208446.creator: Agus Maryoto, Nor Intang Setyo Hermanto, Voilla Oktaviani
pmc-13208446.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The increasing demand for sustainable construction materials has intensified interest in reusing ceramic waste as a supplementary material in cementitious systems due to its potential to reduce environmental impacts and enhance resource efficiency. Previous studies indicated that ceramic roof tile waste powder (CTP) with a fineness value greater than that of cement did not contribute to an enhancement in the compressive strength of mortar. This study investigates CTP with a higher fineness than cement.

pmc-13414669.title: Assessing Satisfaction in Simulation Among Medical Students: Psychometric Validation of the Italian Version of the Satisfaction with Simulation Experience Scale
pmc-13414669.creator: Samuel Agostino, Elena Casabona, Massimiliano Abate Daga, Franco Veglio, Alberto Milan, Grazia Papotti, Beatrice Albanesi
pmc-13414669.description: Background: Simulation-based education (SBE) is increasingly integrated into medical curricula to enhance clinical reasoning, reflective practice, and experiential learning in safe educational environments. Evaluating learners’ satisfaction is essential to assess the educational impact of simulation activities. Although the Satisfaction with Simulation Experience Scale (SSE) has been internationally validated, no robust psychometric validation has been conducted among Italian medical students.

pmc-13679316.title: RNA base-modification and A-to-I editing landscapes of oxidatively stressed human retinal pigment epithelium under Quantum Molecular Resonance electrotherapy and blood-derived secretome
pmc-13679316.creator: Domenico Mordà, Simona Alibrandi, Concetta Scimone, Angela D’ascola, Federica Aliquò, Giorgia Abate, Gianantonio Pozzato, Sergio Zaccaria Scalinci, Rosalia D’angelo, Antonina Sidoti, Luigi Donato
pmc-13679316.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Chemical modifications of RNA bases and adenosine-to-inosine (A-to-I) editing are regulatory layers essentially unexplored in the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE), whose oxidative dysfunction underlies age-related macular degeneration. We mapped both layers in ARPE-19 cells exposed to tert-butyl hydroperoxide under two non-pharmacological interventions, Quantum Molecular Resonance (QMR) electrotherapy and a patient blood-derived secretome, across 56 libraries spanning four arms, three time points and matched stressed and stress-free conditions (GEO: GSE328981).
